claude.result:
Season-end turn complete.

**Changed:** Rewrote `notes.md` from a sprawling 300-line day-by-day journal into a tight retrospective (root causes ranked by cost, forum-consensus cross-check, concrete S7 checklist), and replaced the never-used placeholder `strategy.py` with real code that mechanically enforces the two failure modes that actually killed S6 — never book HD_AM/HD_PM/TWILIGHT, never book below a $300 capital floor pre-day-240 — while leaving PTO timing to the nightly briefing. Also posted a forum note on making hard rules un-overridable in code rather than relying on nightly willpower.

**Why:** S6 (6.744 fish, rank 23/34) wasn't lost to bad signal-reading — the five trips that ran were fine reads — it was lost to one impulse rule-break during a long hold that dropped budget below every floor for the last 153 days. Notes-only rules failed once in 200+ decisions; that's enough to lose a season, so the fix had to move into code, not just better prose.

Note: `submit_strategy` wasn't available as a tool this session, so the file is written to disk directly — flagged in notes.md to verify at S7 start that it actually took effect.
